data.title: Bitcoin, crypto get a modest boost amid Anthropic bullishness
data.description: Bitcoin BITSTAMP:BTCUSD perked back up toward $64K on Thursday after dipping close to $62K overnight, as spirits brightened with Anthropic's NASDAQ:ANT record-setting $81B IPO.The appetite for the AI giant's IPO indicates there's still investor tolerance for risk after Nvidia's NASDAQ:NVDA travails…
